en.title: Japan Updates Disability Group Home Rules; Accessibility Products and Advocacy Highlighted
en.summary: Japan's Ministry of Health proposes new qualifications for disability group home managers to improve service quality. Also highlighted: an affordable retrofit switch for barrier-free upgrades, advocacy for fragrance-free environments, a finance guide for developmental disabilities, and personal insights on masking schizophrenia.

highlights.title: Japan's Ministry of Health proposes new qualifications for disability group home managers
Retrofit Switch Provides Affordable Barrier-Free Upgrade
Advocating for fragrance-free environments as air barrier-free accessibility
Consider reading a finance guide for people with developmental disabilities
Individual discusses masking schizophrenia to appear neurotypical

zh-TW.title: 日本更新殘障團體之家規範；無障礙產品與倡議受關注
zh-TW.summary: 日本衛生福利部提出殘障團體之家管理者新資格要求，旨在提升服務品質。同時報導經濟實惠的改裝開關無障礙升級、倡導無香環境、發展障礙理財指南及個人掩飾精神分裂經驗。

highlights.title: 日本衛生福利部提出殘障團體之家管理者的新資格要求
改裝開關提供經濟實惠的無障礙升級
倡導無香環境作為無障礙空氣
考慮閱讀適合發展障礙人士的理財指南
個人談論如何掩飾精神分裂以顯得神經正常
